---
title: "Cell type atlas"
output: html_notebook
---

# Load dependencies
```{r message=FALSE}
library(scater)
library(ggraph)
library(igraph)
library(ABAData)
```


# Load object containg Cell type atlas
```{r}
x <- ABAMouseSSv4("data/ABAMouseSSv4")
```


# Display UMAP collored by cell type
```{r}
plotUMAP(x,color_by="subclass_color",text_by="subclass_label",text_size=3) +
  coord_equal() + 
  scale_color_identity()
```

# Example gene expression
```{r}
x <- logNormCounts(x)
plotUMAP(x,color_by="Htr3a",text_by="subclass_label",text_size=3) +
  coord_equal()
```
